question: Which of the following groups represents essential amino acid?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Histidine, isoleucine,leucine,lysine**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct group representing essential amino acids is:**

 
 
• **Histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine**
 
 
 
• Essential amino acids are those that cannot be synthesized by the human body and must be obtained through diet.
 
• There are **nine essential amino acids:**
 
 
• Histidine
 
• Isoleucine
 
• Leucine
 
• Lysine
 
• Methionine
 
• Phenylalanine
 
• Threonine
 
• Tryptophan
 
• Valine
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alanine, arginine, asparagine, aspartic acid** – None of these are essential.

 
 
• While arginine is conditionally essential (for certain groups), the others are non-essential.
 
 
 
• **Alanine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine** – Alanine is not essential, though the others (isoleucine, leucine, lysine) are.
 
• **Glycine, proline, serine, tyrosine** – These are all non-essential amino acids.
